cross_image_findings: Northeast main entrance has a real concave upper facade, porch and curved balcony; southeast has a different ground arch; northwest has a tall arched opening/columns and a rectangular base door. Do not mirror one corner everywhere.
Current northwest photo directly shows the historical short west return adjoining the simplified modern west facade.
Pre-renewal high photo and plan corroborate an incomplete old perimeter and a partial southern historic wing.
Modern courtyard context shows red villa/events hall as separate components, not fillers for the open court.
Section separates new roof pavilion from the old four-storey wall; pixel-scale readings are approximate author estimates.
2011courtyard service additions and2013shop signs/air conditioners are recorded conditions, not required permanent geometry.

scope_decision.subject: 上海公共租界工部局历史主楼 / 工部局大楼 / 老市府大楼; historical north and east wings plus part of the southern wing, with the preserved northwest corner and short west return.
scope_decision.recommended_modeled_extent: Preserved historical street wings only. Keep the new western/southwesternL, independent courtyard villa and events hall, gardens/ground, roof pavilion and underground structures outside the historic replacement scope.
scope_decision.map_authority: Exact preserved-source remainder and partial replacement contract are established in footprint-review.json, with source positional uncertainty explicitly retained.
seam_evidence: Current architect photo plaza08 directly shows northwest old corner and short old west return changing to modern west facade.
Architect plan dca09 and pre-renewal high photo dca06 support partial south-wing termination, but not survey coordinates.
excluded: Modern roof pavilion, basement works, landscaping
HolyTrinity church and opposite street buildings
scope_decision.photo_coverage: Northeast main entrance before/after renewal; southeast street corner; northwest old/new seam; local courtyard; pre-renewal high view and modern component context.

not_proven: Surveyed metre height, floor elevations, every corner height and exact original/current grade.
Georeferenced construction seam coordinates and exact wall thicknesses/inner-court boundaries.
Precise south new/old seam from a close-range current street photo; the plan and pre-renewal high view support its vicinity only.
Every current roof surface/equipment position and whether a given small rooftop element dates from a specific period.
Door-number correspondence and conflicting early construction/completion dates.
Exact source membership and post-move position of red B building; separate events hall is excluded regardless.
